subject: Collection windows & commit validation — Q4 billing gating
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Collection windows & commit validation — Q4 billing gating

Team — quick finance heads-up for Acme Health (RDW-14523) and a couple of EU deals: we need to lock billing/PO timing so bookings can be recognized in November. Key asks: 

1) Sales hygiene: please update stage + commit flags in SFDC for any deals with PO ETA within Nov/Dec by end-of-day 2026-11-03. Most common failure we see is a "Verbal Commit" lingering without PO date.

2) PO timing gating: if PO date is after 11/15 the booking will slip to Dec recognition under our month-close rules unless we have an invoice-ready PO with explicit bill-to date. Confirm correct PO ETA and whether Acme can provide a signed PDF.

3) Procurement dependencies: we need a copy of the PO and any billing instructions (VAT EORI for EU) to pass to Finance. If procurement asks for SOW or revised payment terms, flag immediately — that creates a dependency.

I've attached a short spreadsheet with the collection windows matrix and suggested labeling for SFDC fields (collection_windows_q4.xlsx). Please confirm by EOD Tue (11/03). If we don't have signed PO or confirmed invoice date by 11/15 cut, estimate will roll to Dec.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Finance Partner, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: collection_windows_q4.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Thanks Marcus — noted. Quick clarifications: 

- For EU customers (Acme included) does Finance need full VAT registration details before we can accept an invoice date within the Nov window? My understanding is we can accept an invoice date but we need billing entity + VAT ID to actually post revenue.

- For Acme specifically: procurement asked yesterday if Redwood can accept a PO with a 30-day payment net + electronic signature. I told them I'd confirm whether that impacts recognition date.

I'll reach out to the Acme contact to ask for the signed PO PDF and VAT details; copying draft language below before I send.

Hi Neha / Marcus — thanks for the note. Quick update from procurement: 

- We expect the signed PO to be available by 2026-11-03 (internal approval flows are complete). I will attach the signed PO PDF as soon as it's issued.
- Billing instructions: Acme Health (EU) will include VAT ID (IT-04567891234) on the PO. Please confirm the billing entity name you require on invoice — we have a couple of variants in our system.
- Payment terms: Net 30 is standard for us; we can accept an e-signed PO (DocuSign). If Redwood needs earlier recognition we can request expedited approval, but that's unlikely before 11/15.

We attached the draft PO for your review (Acme_PO_draft_20261103.pdf). Let me know if you need any additional fields on the PO.

Best,

Subject: Re: Collection windows & commit validation — Q4 billing gating

Great — thanks Elena and Neha for the fast turn. Actions and next steps: 

- Neha / Marissa: when the signed PO arrives, please update SFDC: set Stage = Closed-Won (if legal & billing fields are present), Commit = "Final" and PO Date = 2026-11-03 (or actual). That will allow Finance to queue for Nov recognition if PO date <= 11/15 and invoice-ready.
- Finance will need the VAT ID exactly as shown on the PO. Elena: please confirm the billing entity string you want on the invoice (example: "Acme Health S.p.A.").
- If Acme confirms Net 30 via e-sign, that's fine — recognition gating remains PO-date driven; payment timing does not block recognition once invoice is issued and other controls are satisfied.

I also uploaded the HubSpot deal and linked the DocuSign envelope here: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9876543 and https://www.docusign.com/center/sign/abc123.

I'll mark this thread resolved once SFDC is updated and Finance confirms posting. Thanks team.
